### volcano_go_combo

#### Percentage-difference volcano plot with GO bar chart combination（单细胞百分比差火山图加GO条形组合图）

**Stable ID:** `cell-fig2h-volcano-go-combo` · **Plot family:** `volcano_go_combo` · **Language:** R

[Preview](../../assets/personal-modules/previews/cell-fig2h-volcano-go-combo/preview.png) · [Thumbnail](../../assets/personal-modules/thumbs/cell-fig2h-volcano-go-combo.jpg) · [Module source](https://github.com/jarxunlai/ScientificFigureLibrary-personal/tree/644ab1034ca358f1584c2ec8666f1036f495f38e/modules/cell-fig2h-volcano-go-combo)
